description: This file defines the LDAPUserLookupSetting class, which encapsulates configuration settings for LDAP user lookup operations within the OrangeHRM LDAP plugin. It includes properties such as base DN, search scope, user attribute mappings, and methods for setting, getting, and serializing these configurations.

classes.name: LDAPUserLookupSetting
classes.description: Represents LDAP user lookup configuration settings, including base DN, search scope, user attributes, and mapping for employee selector.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the LDAPUserLookupSetting with a specified base distinguished name (DN) and creates a default LDAPEmployeeSelectorMapping.

methods.name: getBaseDN
methods.description: Returns the base DN used for LDAP searches.

methods.name: getSearchScope
methods.description: Returns the current search scope (subtree or one level).

methods.name: setSearchScope
methods.description: Sets the LDAP search scope, validating that it is either 'sub' or 'one'.

methods.name: getUserNameAttribute
methods.description: Returns the attribute used as username in LDAP entries.

methods.name: setUserNameAttribute
methods.description: Sets the LDAP attribute that corresponds to the username.

methods.name: getUserUniqueIdAttribute
methods.description: Returns the LDAP attribute used as a unique user identifier.

methods.name: setUserUniqueIdAttribute
methods.description: Sets the LDAP attribute used as a unique user identifier.

methods.name: getUserSearchFilter
methods.description: Returns the LDAP search filter used when querying for users.

methods.name: setUserSearchFilter
methods.description: Sets the LDAP search filter used when querying for users.

methods.name: getEmployeeSelectorMapping
methods.description: Returns the LDAP employee selector mapping object.

methods.name: setEmployeeSelectorMapping
methods.description: Sets the LDAP employee selector mapping object.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Serializes the LDAPUserLookupSetting object into an associative array.

methods.name: createFromArray
methods.description: Creates an LDAPUserLookupSetting instance from an associative array of settings.
